title: The 10 Best Pet Cameras
subtitle: Treat-tossing and pan-tilt cameras for checking on pets, ranked.
intro: We pulled the pet cameras on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: treat tossing, 360-degree view, and whether core features need a subscription.
systems_note: Tapo cameras have an official TP-Link integration in Home Assistant.

buyers_guide.a: Many pet cameras lock barking alerts, cloud video, and AI features behind a monthly plan. Check what the free tier includes; some Furbo listings require a plan just to activate.

buyers_guide.q: Treat tossing or just a camera?
buyers_guide.a: Treat cameras let you reward your pet remotely. A regular pan-and-tilt indoor camera is much cheaper if you only want to watch and talk.

buyers_guide.q: Will it work on my Wi-Fi?
buyers_guide.a: Most need 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; some also support 5 GHz. Put the camera within good range of your router.
